## History

During a summer stay at a boardinghouse in [Prospect Point](../codex/places.md#prospect-point), Cousin Emily was among the quirky boarders observed by [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md). [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) described these fellow boarders and recounted her time with them in a letter written to [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md).

_Sources: [v3 ch.Jonas P1](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0001), [v3 ch.Jonas P3](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0003), [v3 ch.Jonas P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 ch.Jonas P23](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0023)_

## Relationships

### [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/cousin-emily--phil-gordon.md)

Cousin Emily is related to [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) as her father's second cousin. She wrote a letter to [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) detailing her summer stay at a boardinghouse in [Prospect Point](../codex/places.md#prospect-point), where she described her quirky fellow boarders. In the letter, she also shared her growing and conflicted affection for [Jonas](../character/jonas.md) [Blake](../character/jonas.md), an earnest theological student preaching in the area.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Jonas P1](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0001), [v3 ch.Jonas P2](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0002), [v3 ch.Jonas P3](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0003), +2 more_
